claims.claim_vi: A pipeline is commonly described in five phases: collect, ingest, store, compute, consume; compute covers cleansing, aggregation and format conversion in batch or stream.
claims.verified_by: Carried from the source as a general description; read, not independently checked.

claims.claim_vi: Data lakes and data warehouses are the storage roles named in the store phase.
Kafka describes at-most-once, at-least-once and exactly-once delivery; at-least-once can write duplicates when a producer retries after a lost acknowledgement.
claims.verified_by: Search-result excerpt only; the page itself was not opened (host blocked in the authoring environment).

claims.claim_vi: An idempotent producer deduplicates with a producer id and sequence number; Kafka transactions do not make external side effects exactly-once.
claims.verified_by: Search-result excerpt only; the page itself was not opened (host blocked in the authoring environment). The external-side-effect caveat was stated by a third-party guide in the same results.

design_notes_vi: Năm giai đoạn dọc với ví dụ cửa hàng trực tuyến tự đặt; thẻ cuối nêu lỗi gửi lại làm trùng dòng. So sánh lô/luồng là giải thích của người biên soạn, không phải tuyên bố có nguồn. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source describes the phases abstractly; the lesson adds a concrete example and the duplicate-delivery limitation, which the source does not mention.
Source lists consumers (dashboards, BI, ML) generically; the lesson shortens it to three examples.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
